content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TISS Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Assistant Professor post at TISS is 16th September 2026. It is advisable to apply well in advance to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in Sociology and have cleared NET/SLET/SET or hold a PhD. Alternatively, a PhD from a foreign university ranked among the top 500 globally is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for the TISS Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs 1000/- for General/OBC candidates and Rs 250/- for SC/ST/PWD candidates. Women candidates are exempted from paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive an entry pay of Rs. 57700/- in Academic Pay level 10 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the TISS Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of TISS. The application process involves filling out the online form, uploading necessary documents, and paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any age limit for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The official notification mentions relaxation of qualifications based on work experience and age relaxation for persons already holding comparable positions. Specific age limits are not detailed here, so please refer to the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor role at TISS?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves a presentation and an interview, followed by verification of documents. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for precise details.

faq.question: Q8. Does TISS offer contract positions for Assistant Professors?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment notification indicates that the Assistant Professor position is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Assistant Professor in Sociology at the TISS Guwahati Campus.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for TISS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' heading.
